_note: Launchpad config (PREVIEW). Factories and omni escrows are NOT deployed on any chain; addresses stay null until an audited deploy. Abstract is excluded (shutting down).

lzEstUsd._note: LayerZero V2 fee estimates per message, USD. Fork quotes Oct 17 2026, 2 DVNs (foot-wallets/contracts/mainnet/FORK_DRYRUN.md). REQUEST ~ +$0.04 for the 2.4M hub gas (AT_MINT) or ~ +$0.03 for the 1.6M hub gas (BATCHED). Real fees come from escrow.quoteFanout / quoteRequest.

perIdLzUsd._note: extra destination gas per additional id in one batched message (~30k gas), USD at today's gas; Ethereum busy (3 gwei) ~0.22

batch._note: BATCHED copy mode (default for multichain drops): Base queues escrow copies and flushes one LayerZero message per chain per batch. K = ids per batch, T = minutes after the oldest queued id. Per-id pool share = (batch quote / K) x (1 + buffer). Mirrors MultiSeaOmniDrop MIN_K/MAX_K/MIN_T/MAX_T and MultiSeaOmniEscrow.shareBufferBps.
